https://www.alamedaunified.org/board/agendas-minutes

11/10 at 6:30pm
Can make public comment online, by phone or in person

Public Comments - This public comment period is designated for matters within the jurisdiction of the Board of Education that are not listed on the agenda. Members of the public may provide comments in person or electronically via computer, tablet, or smartphone. Individuals wishing to speak must submit a speaker slip (in person) or utilize the “Raise Hand” feature on Zoom (virtual). Once the public comment period has commenced, no additional speaker slips or raised hands will be accepted. In the event of technical difficulties or meeting disruptions, the Board reserves the right to discontinue public comment via Zoom at any time. Members of the public who are unable to participate in the meeting may submit written comments to: klonergan@alamedaunified.org. The Board may limit public comments under this agenda item to 20 minutes with any remaining comments coming at the end of General Business.
